parameterReassigned.text: `{{name}}` came in from the caller, and this line gives it a new value, so every later use of it means something other than what was passed, with nothing at the place of use to say so. Put the new value in a variable of its own, named for what it has become, and leave `{{name}}` holding what the caller gave.

parameterAddressTaken.text: This takes the address of `{{name}}`, which came in from the caller, and whatever holds the pointer can give `{{name}}` a new value that nothing in this function shows. Copy it into a variable of its own, named for what it is for, and take the address of that, so `{{name}}` keeps what the caller gave.
